== Biography ==
'''Marion Wilson, also called Jarden''', is named by W.H. Hill as the wife of the senior John Hutcheson in Gairbraid and mother of Thomas Hutcheson, father of George and Thomas, the charitable founders.<ref name="Hill (1902)p53">W.H. Hill, ''The Early Records of an Old Glasgow Family'' (1902), [https://archive.org/download/earlyrecordsofol00hill/page/n78.jpg printed p. 53]. Printed page visually inspected13 November 2026; underlying charter and genealogical manuscripts uninspected.</ref>

Hill reports a charter of confirmation dated19 November 1582 favouring John, Marion Wilson aliter Jarden and their eldest son John. This supplies a conservative record-derived birth upper bound before 1583 for Marion. It does not provide an exact birthday, age, birthplace, evidence she was still alive in 1582, or a death date.<ref name="Hill (1902)p53" />

Hill explicitly calls [[Hutcheson-1647|Thomas Hutcheson]], the founders’ father, the younger son of John and Marion. Their eldest son John married Agnes, daughter of William Anderson of Stobcross and Janet Maxwell. Agnes belongs to that eldest son John’s family; she is not the mother assigned to Thomas in this account.<ref name="Hill (1902)p53" />

== Research Notes ==
Wilson and Jarden are recorded name forms. Neither is independently proved here to be a maiden surname, and no parents are assigned to Marion. This is one source-defined woman, not two women created from the alias.

The existing John profile has combined senior identity and eldest son’s wife. Its father assessment remains uncertain without a percentage. The imported Agnes-as-Thomas’s-mother role remains on hold. This draft does not perform a live parent replacement or merge. The local working account selects Marion as Thomas’s mother with an uncertain qualitative assessment and no individual percentage, on this explicit compiled statement. The charter original remains uninspected.

The original 1582 confirmation cited by Hill (Genealogical MSS. of Hills etc., No.5), the 1881 Hospital history pp. 5–6, and compatible existing profile identities are the next checks. The compatible GPYT-31C household is used as a qualified working identification; its additional dates and ancestors are not established.

A public mention of Marion Wilson with William Maxwell has no own checkable person ID or identity bridge. It remains an unresolved lead and is not excluded as necessarily a different woman. Three bounded official WikiTree queries and the project QMD search found no compatible person profile ID; that is not an exhaustive proof of absence.

The fresh own-family readback for FamilySearch GPYT-31C is a compatible medium person match: wife of GPYR-JMS with eldest John GPYR-GNX. Its displayed dates, parents and extra Sir Knight James are unproved and are not copied; FamilySearch GPYT-31C is now linked to Thomas PJ3T-SGD as a qualified uncertain working mother, verified after saving; the original charter remains uninspected and no percentage is assigned. This does not endorse the inherited dates, parents or extra children. No live WikiTree edit has been performed.
